core.notify.readonly: This copy is read-only, so this can't be saved right now.
core.notify.not_configured: E-mail isn't set up yet, so nothing can be sent. Set the mail server and the sender address in settings.
core.notify.templates.title: E-mail templates
core.notify.templates.intro: The wording of every e-mail this site sends. Open a language to change it; what you save replaces the shipped text for that language.
core.notify.templates.gone_body: Customised wording for templates that nothing sends any more. You can remove it.
core.notify.templates.remove_body: The customised wording is deleted. Nothing sends this template, so nothing else changes.
core.notify.test.title: Send me a test
core.notify.test.body: Queues a short test message to your own address, to check that e-mail arrives.
core.notify.edit.title: Edit template
core.notify.edit.subject: Subject
core.notify.edit.preview_note: Shown with placeholder values. Nothing is saved or sent.
core.notify.edit.reset_body: Your customised wording for this language is deleted and the shipped text is used again.
core.notify.edit.fields_body: Write a field in double braces, for example the first one. Press a field to copy it.
core.notify.edit.copy_failed: Couldn't copy. Select the text and copy it yourself.
core.notify.edit.default_note: What this template says without any customising. It can't be changed here.
core.notify.outbox.title: E-mail outbox
core.notify.outbox.check_ok: The mail server answered and accepted the sign-in.
core.notify.outbox.caption: Messages
core.notify.outbox.cancel_body: The message is deleted and never sent.
core.notify.outbox.expired_error: This message has expired, so it can't be sent again. Trigger the action again.
core.notify.outbox.conflict: This message can't be changed now: it is being sent, was sent, or isn't failed.
core.notify.template.test.title: Test message
module.notify.title: E-mail
module.notify.permission.templates.manag: Change the wording of e-mails and send a test
module.notify.permission.outbox.manage.t: See the e-mail outbox, retry and cancel messages, check the connection
module.notify.field.parse: {line, select, none {The template has a mistake.} other {The template has a mistake on line {line}.}}
core.notify.setting.smtp_host.title: Mail server
core.notify.setting.smtp_host.descriptio: The host name of the mail server that sends this site's e-mail. Leave it empty to turn e-mail off.
core.notify.setting.smtp_port.title: Mail server port
core.notify.setting.smtp_port.descriptio: Usually 587 for STARTTLS or 465 for TLS.
core.notify.setting.smtp_security.title: Connection security
core.notify.setting.smtp_security.descri: How the connection to the mail server is protected. Use "none" only for a test server on a trusted network.
core.notify.setting.smtp_username.title: Mail server user name
core.notify.setting.smtp_username.descri: Leave it empty if the server needs no sign-in.
core.notify.setting.smtp_password.title: Mail server password
core.notify.setting.smtp_password.descri: Stored sealed and never shown again. Replace it to change it.
core.notify.setting.sender_address.title: Sender address
core.notify.setting.sender_name.title: Sender name
core.notify.setting.sender_name.descript: The name shown next to the sender address.
core.notify.setting.reply_to.title: Reply-to address
core.notify.setting.reply_to.description: Where replies go. Leave it empty to use the sender address.
core.notify.setting.alert_addresses.desc: Where the alert goes when the superuser signs in. Separate addresses with commas.
core.notify.setting.retention.title: How long to keep the record of sent messages
core.notify.setting.retention.descriptio: Sent and failed messages are removed from the outbox after this long. Zero keeps them forever.
